title: THE DECISIVE EXPERIMENT (SP-CARM + SP9): arm C = classical design at the MEAN state (TWIN §4 as written) vs arm C := argmax of the DESIGN-PHASE SWEEP (best-on-mu classical member, values only, before any arm-P run) + bound screen (delta_practice gate) + literature fixed design as attribution arm; and the shape/ordering of the decisive result (plug-only vs bell-first + plug-conditional; the ceiling/screen arm; the two-sector embedding)
question: Is 'classical design at the mean conditions only' the STRONGEST opponent a competent designer would field on the truncated plug (T4 says the ideal plug wants the PEAK pressure; the field's practice is already a cycle-averaged sweep), or must the TWIN protocol be amended (A-CARM) so that arm C := the design-phase-sweep argmax over a grid of Dirac-mu design states containing <Pc>, the mass-flux/thrust-consistent states and the peak P_CJ, with the spread_C, delta_practice and Delta_Ab decision rules pre-registered? Is the METHOD claim separable from the DATA claim without it? Must a bound screen (delta_practice <= 0.5% => MATERIAL unreachable by theorem [T-GB], pivot per G2 wording WITHOUT running arm P) precede the campaign? Which decisive-result TUPLE answers Q0 (configuration output of {bell, truncated plug} at the true c; comparator = the designer's best across sectors; value stack + bound gap + operability rows) and at what cost vs the statement's 7-10 session budget?
incumbent: TWIN protocol §4 arm C = 'the classical design of the SAME geometry class at the I4 interface (<Pc>, T0, gamma — mean conditions only): the literature's fixed design (Rao-class plug / peak design at mean point), built by the SAME engine and certified by the SAME stack'; §5 identical constraints (eps, L, truncation, p_b object, class/floors, tables/mu/representation); §6 metric delta = (Isp_P - Isp_C)/Isp_C with MATERIAL/SMALL/INTERMEDIATE/NON-CONCLUSIVE branches at 1%/0.5%; no design-phase sweep, no bound screen before the campaign, no attribution arm; the SP-CARM judge classifies the comparator axis NO-ROW in the ledger and single-author in the protocol (F2-B0).
alternative: A-CARM (SP-CARM judge §4 + §7; red team A-3/A-9/A-10; trees: variational S0.2/S0.5 control arms + K.3/K.5, optimization C.3 comparator + C.4 refuter run + S13 bound screen, propulsion SP-CARM tuned practice, hyperbolic S12 bracket-only): (i) arm C := argmax over the DESIGN-PHASE SWEEP Sigma_C(xi_d) evaluated on the SAME mu and representation as arm P (one session, O(10) designs, values only, BEFORE any arm-P run) with pre-registered rules — spread_C > band => TWIN §4 'mean only' REFUTED as the strongest design, amendment pins arm C := sweep argmax (+ the literature's GENO fixed design as the attribution arm); spread_C <= band => comparator identity IMMATERIAL on this instance and the sweep is the record datum on [T-T4] sharpness; (ii) delta_practice := (J_ideal - J_avg(arm C))/J_ideal <= 0.5% => the MATERIAL branch is unreachable by theorem ([T-GB]) and the campaign pivots per the G2 wording WITHOUT running arm P (the trees' Jensen/ceiling screen); (iii) Delta_Ab base-area term > band/3 => base radius becomes a §5 pin or the term enters §6; (iv) the decisive result read as a value stack (delta*; each arm vs bell-at-<Pc> at the same c; bound gap; operability rows) and, as a USER-priced option, embedded as the plug-sector row of the two-sector tournament at the true c (+1-2 sessions, at the budget ceiling). Kill for the falsifier itself: an engine that cannot build a Dirac-mu classical plug at the peak phase within the certification floors.
advocate_persona: the propulsion-journal referee who has designed and fired aerospikes (the trees' propulsion lens) together with the record's SP-CARM judge: argue that a mean-state arm C is a straw man and that the sweep + screen are preconditions of a publishable comparison; price them against the F3.TWIN window (one 3 h decisive window) and state which of the three decision rules would make YOU abandon the amendment
refuter_persona: two hats: (1) the TWIN protocol author (F2-B0) defending pre-registration discipline and constraint identity — attack the amendment as scope creep, as a change of the pre-registered comparator after the fact, and as a cost the F3 budget (3-4 sessions) does not carry; (2) the variational/record advocate who reads T3/T4 ([T-T3] M0 :746, [T-T4] :2294): at the mean state the bell is classical BY THEOREM and the plug's peak design is the T4 object — attack any sweep member that is not a certifiable design (A-1 margin rule) and any claim that the sweep changes the METHOD claim rather than the DATA claim

title: SEARCH STRATEGY at the certification boundary (SP4, narrowly scoped): certify-inside-the-loop (segmented TR-Newton, certify-then-accept P4 gate, local-only) vs explore-then-certify (multistart + amplitude homotopy from the classical seed, DFO/BO engine on the cheap tier, ONE terminal certification with margin + ONE certified back-projection) — deliverable = the PRE-REGISTRATION of PILOT-CB, not its execution

Is the in-loop certify-then-accept closer the right paradigm for this class, or does explore-then-certify (the trees' 4/4 posture) reach certified designs the closer cannot price? What is the pre-registered pilot (arms, budget, outcomes K1/K2/K3/K3') that settles it BEFORE the arms of the decisive test run, and who owns it (F2.ENGINE first act vs F2.REPR joint clause REF-13)?
incumbent: Reduced-space (NAND) segmented TR-Newton via scipy trust-constr with the certify-then-accept P4 gate (record-failure policy C23 DECIDED); certification boundary = implicit set membership, binary outside gates (C28 MIXED: quantifier bridge FALSIFIED); margin-constrained KKT with the margin multiplier (M0 Part VI ladder, [X-MGOV] governor with KS aggregation C27); local-only exploration (C57 MIXED; deflation + sector tournament = declared apparatus never executed; user-ratified one-case pilot decided at F2.REPR); C38 outcome-II declaration NEVER; NAND structural reason (M0 :4250-4299). advocate_persona: the numerical-optimization / DFO engineer of the trees (optimization lens S7/S8 + hyperbolic S11): argue explore-then-certify at its genuine best on THIS class (S22 cert-limited instance of record), price PILOT-CB honestly (both arms, both recorders, envfp pinned, equal budget), and state which outcome (K2) would make you abandon it

question: Is a design 'quotable' under A-1 (cert_worst <= 1/K_RICH under the pinned recorder) a sufficient stability margin, when the record's own S22 base already shows a cross-triple cert_worst ratio of 6.6 > K_RICH = 4 (SP8 judge F-1)? What is the M0-ready REQUIREMENT text and the pre-registered protocol (design set, both recorders, >= 2 lowerings, pass/fail rule, seeded rejectors), owner F2.ENGINE first act — NO RUN in this session?
incumbent: Certificate stack of M0 VI.6 (:3181-3188); per-cell Newton certification in z-space with the roundoff floor NTF = eta kappa_q (M0 :3654 ff.; C17 trip cap 30 / C18 NEWTON_TOL_FACTOR = 100, C_FLOOR = 8 — SINGLE-AUTHOR); certification metric scale C19 (DECIDED on cost), qualification C20 (MIXED); two-level Richardson K = 4 with the K_RICH numeral in 8 roles (C41/C42/C43); certificate = property of (tree, recorder, env) MEASURED on three instances (M0 :4250-4299: outcome classes reproduce, binary verdicts near the bound do not); TWIN A-1 (quotable iff cert_worst <= 1/K_RICH under the pinned recorder; marginal band (1/K_RICH, 1] quotable only if both recorders agree) DECLARED, NOT implemented; closure-aware staleness gate (tests/test_claims_lint.py: envfp, fail= grammar); X-O32 / X-LOCD / X-AKNO FAILING of record; the S-CERT verdict NON-CERTIFICABILE (2 P0, 2026-08-13).
